EMKAY.NS.d: Emkay Global Financial Services Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides stock broking, institutional equities, investment banking, portfolio management, and wealth management services in India. The company offers equity broking, asset management, currency and commodity advisory and broking, trading and investment education, investment management, alternative investment fund, lending, depository participant, wealth and investment advisory, and retail broking services.

FAZE3Q.NS.d: Faze Three Limited, established in 1982 and based in Mumbai, makes and distributes home textiles and automotive fabrics. Its home range includes bathmats, rugs, blankets, cushions, carpets, curtains, table linens, bedding and kitchen textiles. It also produces face masks, vehicle seat covers, pet accessories and outdoor items like furniture covers and awning materials.

GLOBUSSPR.NS.d: Globus Spirits Limited manufactures and sells alcohol in India. It offers Indian made Indian liquor products under the Nimboo, Narangi, Goldee, Ghoomar, and Heer Ranjha brands; and Indian made foreign liquor products under the County Club, French Castle, Hannibal Legendary, and White Lace brands. The company is also involved in franchise bottling and bulk alcohol hand sanitizer production activities. It also exports its products to Western Europe, Western Africa, and Southern African countries.

HBPOR.NS.d: HB Portfolio Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker HBPOR and traded in INR. Its country is India.

HDIL.NS.d: Housing Development and Infrastructure Limited engages in the real estate construction, development, and other related activities in India. Its residential projects include apartment complexes, towers, and townships; commercial projects comprise office spaces and multiplex cinemas; and retail projects consists of shopping malls. The company also develops slum rehabilitation projects. Housing Development and Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Mumbai, India.

KAMDHENU.NS.d: Kamdhenu Limited manufactures, distributes, and markets steel, and paint and allied products under the Kamdhenu brand name in India. It operates through Steel and Paints segments. The company offers thermo-mechanically-treated bars and rebars; and structural steel, such as angles, channels, beam sections, flats, rounds, and squares. It also provides paint products that comprise exterior and interior emulsions, water based primers, wood finishes, aluminum paints, and textured and designer paints.

KJMCFIN.NS.d: KJMC Financial Services Limited is an Indian financial services company that offers a range of services including wealth management, equity broking, and investment advisory services. The company focuses on providing tailored financial solutions to individual and institutional clients. They are headquartered in India.

KUSUMGAR.NS.d: Kusumgar Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker KUSUMGAR and traded in INR. Its country is India.

LRRPL.NS.d: Lead Reclaim & Rubber Products Ltd. is an India-based company engaged in the manufacturing and recycling of rubber products. The company primarily produces reclaimed rubber, crumb rubber powder, and rubber granules, including whole tire reclaim rubber, butyl reclaim rubber, and natural reclaim rubber. These products are derived from recycled scrap rubber, emphasizing sustainability and environmental responsibility.

MAJESAUT.NS.d: Majestic Auto Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker MAJESAUT and traded in INR. Its country is India.

MARALOVER.NS.d: Maral Overseas Limited manufactures and sells cotton yarns, knitted fabrics, and garments in India and internationally. It operates in three segments: Yarn, Fabric, and Textile Made-Ups.

NH.NS.d: Narayana Hrudayalaya Limited provides healthcare services. The company operates a chain of multispecialty, tertiary, and primary healthcare facilities. It offers services in approximately 30 specialties, including cardiology and cardiac surgery, cancer care, neurology and neurosurgery, endocrinology, orthopedics, nephrology and urology, obstetrics, pediatrics, neonatology, gynecology, oncology, and gastroenterology.

NIVABUPA.NS.d: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited provides health insurance in India. Its products include individual, family, senior citizen, personal accident and critical illness plans, travel insurance including international and study-abroad plans, and corporate cover such as group health, personal accident and OPD.

OIL.NS.d: Oil India Limited explores for, develops, and produces crude oil and natural gas in India and internationally. The company operates through Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG), Pipeline Transportation, and Renewal Energy segments. It is also involved in the transportation of crude oil and natural gas; and production of LPG, as well as in the provision of exploration and production related services.

PCBL.NS.d: PCBL Limited is an Indian company that produces, supplies and exports carbon black to domestic and international markets, operating Carbon Black and Power divisions. It sells rubber-sector grades under the Orient Black brand and Royale Black specialty blacks for non-rubber uses.

RAJESHEXPO.NS.d: Rajesh Exports Limited, a gold refiner, manufactures, wholesales, and retails gold and diamond jewelry, and various gold products in India. It operates retail showrooms under the SHUBH Jewellers brand name. The company also exports its products. Rajesh Exports Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

RCF.NS.d: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited manufactures and sells fertilizers and industrial chemicals primarily in India. The company operates through Fertilizers, Industrial Chemicals, and Trading segments.

RTNPOWER.NS.d: RattanIndia Power Limited engages in power generation, distribution, trading and transmission, and other ancillary and related activities in India. It is involved in the development of 2 coal based thermal power projects with an aggregate capacity of 5,400 MW, including 2,700 MW project at Nandgaonpeth in Amravati district and 2,700 MW project at Sinnar in Nasik district, in the State of Maharashtra.

RVNL.NS.d: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited engages in the construction of rail infrastructure projects in India. It undertakes rail project development and implementation, as well as provides financial resources mobilization services. The company executes various railway projects, including new lines, doubling, gauge conversion, railway electrification, metro projects, workshops, bridges, construction of cable stayed bridges, institution buildings, etc.

SHIPROCKET.NS.d: Shiprocket Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SHIPROCKET and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SHUKRAPHAR.NS.d: Shukra Pharmaceuticals Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical company involved in the manufacturing and marketing of pharmaceutical products. They produce various formulations and APIs. The company is based in India.

SHYAMTEL.NS.d: Shyam Telecom Limited trades in telephone, mobile phone, and communication equipment and parts in India. It also distributes home appliances. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in New Delhi, India.

SRTRANSFIN-Z9.NS.d: Sec Red NCD 9.7% Sr.VII represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, offering a fixed interest rate of 9.7% and belonging to Series VII of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

STLSTRINF.NS.d: Steel Strips Infrastructures Limited is an India-based company involved in infrastructure development and related activities. The company engages in the development of industrial parks, warehousing facilities, and other infrastructure projects. Steel Strips Infrastructures Limited is headquartered in Chandigarh, India.

SYSTANGO.NS.d: Systango Technologies Ltd. is a digital engineering company that provides a comprehensive range of IT and product engineering services to diverse organizations globally. Its primary services include custom software development, web and mobile application development, cloud engineering and cloud-native solutions, and data engineering. The company specializes in emerging technologies, offering solutions in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Web3 and Blockchain development.

TATACONSUM.NS.d: Tata Consumer Products Limited, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells tea, coffee, and water in India, the United States, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company operates through Branded Business and Non Branded Business segments. It engages in processing and blending of tea, including the manufacture of instant tea. The company's products include salt, pulses, spices, ready-to-eat products, snacks, besan, and other packaged foods.

TATASTEEL.NS.d: Tata Steel Limited manufactures and distributes steel products in India and internationally. It operates in Tata Steel India, Bamnipal Steel (including Tata Steel BSL), Other Indian Operations, Tata Steel Europe, Other Trade Related Operations, and Rest of the World segments.

TVVISION.NS.d: TV Vision Limited engages in the television programming and broadcasting activities in India. The company operates Mastiii, a Hindi music television channel that provides youth and music genre content; Maiboli, a regional Marathi channel, which offers songs and movies; and Dabangg, a Hindi general entertainment channel in Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Jharkhand.

UNITEDPOLY.NS.d: United Polyfab Gujarat Limited produces and sells yarns, including cotton yarn, and fabrics such as dyed, grey and denim. It began operating in 2010 as United Polyfab (Unit-II) Limited and adopted its current name in December 2015. The company is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

V2RETAIL.NS.d: V2 Retail Limited engages in the retail trade of garments, textiles, and accessories in India. The company sells its products under the Godspeed, Herrlich, Glamora, ebellia, and Honey Brats brands. As of May 05, 2021, it operated 93 retail stores. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in New Delhi, India.

WELINV.NS.d: Welspun Investments and Commercials Limited invests and deals in shares and securities in India. The company was formerly known as Welspun Investments Limited and changed its name to Welspun Investments and Commercials Limited in March 2010. Welspun Investments and Commercials Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Mumbai, India. Welspun Investments and Commercials Limited is a subsidiary of Welspun Group Master Trust.
